CustomField.description: Set by the system: the HCP registered for the event before it started (an imported registration, or an attendee entered with Attendance Status = Registered). Stays true after check-in (Attended), so registered-and-checked-in can be told from walk-ins.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when the attendee is Registered; stays checked after check-in.
CustomField.label: Registered
